transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Um... nice to meet you. I guess... well, for the past few weeks, my eating has just been kind of off. 

I'll end up skipping breakfast and lunch without really meaning to. And then... I just sort of pick at dinner, even when my wife cooked. My jeans are starting to feel a little loose, so... yeah. That's mostly why I'm here.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Yeah... I suppose. Just... kind of flat, mostly. 

I'll wake up and just feel a bit heavy, I guess. It's hard to explain. The apartment just feels really quiet, and... I don't know, even trying to play my guitar doesn't really do much for me right now. So... yeah.
Are you still able to enjoy things you usually like?
Um... not really, I guess. Like I said about the guitar... it just doesn't do much for me right now. I don't know... I just haven't really felt like doing much of anything. So... yeah.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn’t worth living?
Um... no. I don't think so. I haven't really had thoughts like that. Just... yeah, no.
Did something stressful happen in your life around the time these changes started?
Um... no. Not really. I can't really think of anything. Just... kind of started feeling this way, I guess.
Have you been trying to lose weight?

Um... no, I haven't been trying to. But... I guess my eating has been kind of off lately. For the past few weeks, I mean. I just... I end up skipping breakfast and lunch, not even on purpose. And then dinner... my wife cooks, but I just kind of pick at it. I don't know. My jeans are feeling a little loose, so... yeah. I guess I've lost some weight, but not on purpose.
How have you been sleeping lately?

Um... I'm sleeping, I guess. But... it's kind of broken up. I keep waking up early, like around four or five. Just... thinking about stuff. Bills, or... some unfinished tracks. And then... I don't know, I just end up feeling tired before the day even really starts. So... yeah.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?

I guess so. Um... yeah. Like, if I try to work on some code or... or arrange a song, I just... I don't know. I end up rereading the same line over and over. Or replaying the same eight bars. And I just... I can't figure out what to do next with it. So... yeah. It's been hard to focus.
Have you been moving or speaking more slowly than usual?

Um... maybe. I guess... things just feel a little slower right now. Like... I'll just sit with my laptop open for ages before I even... move my hands to type. Or plug the keyboard in. It just... takes a while. So... yeah.
Have you been feeling this way nearly every day for at least two weeks?
Um... yeah. I guess so. It's been... about three weeks, maybe. Just... ever since my wife settled into her full-time work schedule. It's just been... like this since then. So... yeah.
Have you been feeling worthless or blaming yourself a lot lately?
Um... I don't think so. Not really. Just... tired, mostly.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy lately?
Um... yeah. I guess so. Just... really drained. It's hard to get going.
Have you had much less appetite lately?

Um... yeah. I guess so. My eating's been... kind of off for the past few weeks. I just... I'll end up skipping breakfast and lunch without really meaning to. And... even when my wife cooks dinner, I just sort of pick at it. I don't know... my jeans are starting to feel a little loose, so... yeah.
Apart from not feeling hungry, have you been afraid of gaining weight?
No. I don't... I don't really care about that right now. Just not hungry.
Has this been making it hard for you to function at work?

Well, I don't... I don't actually have a regular job right now. I'm sort of... trying to get some music projects going. But, um... yeah, it's been hard. I'm doing okay with just... basic stuff around the house, I guess. But the music... it's just stalled. I reached out to some people, some musicians, but I just... haven't followed up. It's just... hard to care.
Because of how you've been feeling, have you been struggling to take care of basic daily tasks?

Um... no, the basic stuff is... it's fine. I can still do what I need to around the house. It's just... like I said, the music projects. I just... haven't followed through with those guys I contacted. Just kind of... stopped.
Would you say these symptoms have clearly interfered with your day-to-day life?

I mean... yeah, I guess. Like I was just saying... I'm still keeping up with the basic things at home. It's mostly just... my projects have stalled. I'm missing chances to follow through with those musicians I contacted. So... yeah.
